gloss: to finish writing; to complete (a work)

definitions.gloss: to finish writing; to complete writing
definitions.explanation: To complete a written work such as a manuscript, novel, report, or thesis. Emphasizes the accomplishment of finishing the entire work.

examples.japanese: {小説|しょうせつ}をようやく{書|か}き{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I finally finished writing my novel.

examples.japanese: {論文|ろんぶん}を{締|し}め{切|き}りまでに{書|か}き{上|あ}げなければならない。
examples.english: I have to finish writing the thesis before the deadline.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}を{一晩|ひとばん}で{書|か}き{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I finished writing the report overnight.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{書|か}き{上|あ}げる → {書|か}き{上|あ}げない (negative)
・{書|か}き{上|あ}げる → {書|か}き{上|あ}げて (te-form)
・{書|か}き{上|あ}げる → {書|か}き{上|あ}げた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {書|か}く (to write) + {上|あ}げる (to finish, to complete)

The ～{上|あ}げる pattern indicates completion of an action, often with a sense of accomplishment.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{原稿|げんこう}を{書|か}き{上|あ}げる - to finish a manuscript
・{論文|ろんぶん}を{書|か}き{上|あ}げる - to complete a thesis
・{小説|しょうせつ}を{書|か}き{上|あ}げる - to finish writing a novel
・{企画書|きかくしょ}を{書|か}き{上|あ}げる - to complete a proposal

SIMILAR COMPOUND VERBS:
・{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる - to finish reading / to read aloud
・{作|つく}り{上|あ}げる - to complete making
・{仕上|しあ}げる - to finish, to complete (similar meaning)
